stem:
A wagon is pushed and begins to move. As the wagon moves, it slows and comes to a stop. The wagon and the direction it is pushed are shown.

What force causes the wagon to stop?

options.label: A
options.text: The force of gravity which is acting in the same direction as the arrow

options.label: B
options.text: The force of friction which is acting in the same direction as the arrow

options.label: C
options.text: The force of gravity which is acting in the opposite direction of the arrow

options.label: D
options.text: The force of friction which is acting in the opposite direction of the arrow

visual_elements: image of a wagon with an arrow pointing right labeled Direction wagon is pushed
